tools.name: nash_list_orders
tools.description: List and search Nash orders (pre-dispatch delivery requests) with filters, sorting and pagination. Returns a slim payload; use nash_get_order for full details. Nash API: GET /v1/orders.

tools.name: nash_get_order
tools.description: Get one Nash order by id: pickup and dropoff details, status, quotes and metadata. Nash API: GET /v1/order/{id}.

tools.name: nash_list_jobs
tools.description: List and search Nash jobs (deliveries) by date, delivery status, provider, courier or text, with pagination. Returns a slim payload; use nash_get_job for details. Nash API: GET /v1/jobs.

tools.name: nash_get_job
tools.description: Get one Nash job (delivery) by id: tasks, courier, status timeline and tracking data. Nash API: GET /v1/jobs/{id}.

tools.name: nash_get_job_by_external_identifier
tools.description: Get one Nash job by the external identifier your system set when it created the job. Nash API: GET /v1/jobs/external_identifier/{externalIdentifier}.

tools.name: nash_list_providers
tools.description: List the delivery providers available to the organization (the couriers and fleets Nash can dispatch to). Nash API: GET /v1/providers.

tools.name: nash_list_routes
tools.description: List and search multi-stop routes with filters, sorting and pagination. Use nash_get_route for stops and metrics. Nash API: GET /v1/routes.

tools.name: nash_get_route
tools.description: Get one route by id: its stops, travel metrics and the orders on it. Nash API: GET /v1/routes/{id}.

tools.name: nash_list_zones
tools.description: List the geographic delivery zones of the organization. Nash API: GET /v1/zones.

tools.name: nash_create_or_update_order
tools.description: Create a pre-dispatch Nash order, or update it when an order with the same externalId exists. It returns priced quotes from eligible providers.
